Name: Prize Ticket Retexture for Vanilla and Natural Accent UI
Author: thirtythreepaces
Description:
Hello! This is a simple mod that retextures the prize ticket item using assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16970]Vanilla Accent Interface[/url] by notbelovely and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21865]Natural Accent Interface[/url] by sinistea. These mods change the prize ticket sprite in the UI, but not the actual item. This mod fixes that!

[b]Config Options:[/b]
[u]PrizeTicket:
[/u][list]
[*]"VanillaAccent" = matches Vanilla Accent Interface (more saturated option)
[*]"NaturalAccent" = matches Natural Accent Interface (less saturated option)
[/list][b]
To install:[/b][u][b]
[/b][/u][list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI and the latest version of Content Patcher (at least 2.2.0) installed.
[*]Download, unzip, and place “[CP] Accent UI Prize Ticket” into your mods folder.
[*]To customize the mod, run SMAPI to generate a “config.json” file and either edit it manually or with Generic Mod Config Menu (I highly recommend the latter).
[*]Done!
[/list]
If you like this mod, you might also like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25143]Mystery Box Retexture for Natural Accent UI[/url]!

Manifest.Name: Accent UI Prize Ticket
Manifest.Description: Changes the sprite of the prize ticket to match Vanilla Accent UI or Natural Accent UI.
Manifest.Author: thirtythreepaces
